children: Hong Kong logistics and minerals trader's annual revenue rose 19% yr/yr
Net loss widened sharply, mainly due to fair value losses on investment properties and convertible notes
Board does not recommend a final dividend for the year
Vision Values intends to use HK$150 mln of convertible-note proceeds to expand logistics electric-truck fleets and facilities
LOGISTICS VOLUME GROWTH – Logistics revenue rose to HK$396.5 mln as freight traffic increased to 2.857 mln tonnes from 2.591 mln tonnes
MINERAL TRADING – Mineral trading contributed HK$37.7 mln in revenue, up from HK$1.0 mln, as a complementary activity to logistics operations
CONVERTIBLE-NOTE REVALUATION – Loss widened sharply as fair-value changes on the 2026 Convertible Notes' derivative component produced a HK$395.4 mln loss
